faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about deterministic domain decision intelligence and valuation methodology.
faq_q1: How does {appName} calculate Net Expected Value without paid APIs?
faq_a1: {appName} utilizes open public telemetry protocols (ICANN RDAP, Internet Archive Wayback CDX, Google Autocomplete commercial tokens, native Node.js DNS resolution) combined with an offline 1,000+ trademark collision trie and TypeSafe JEV System One atomic scoring. All valuation ranges and Net Expected Value models are computed deterministically in TypeScript without incurring paid third-party subscriptions.
faq_q2: What is the difference between Mode A (Buy), Mode B (Renew), and Mode C (Brand)?
faq_a2: Mode A evaluates secondary acquisition viability, fair market retail ranges, and actuarial resale ROI. Mode B analyzes portfolio retention to identify whether an existing asset generates positive carrying cashflow or is a sunk-cost drop candidate. Mode C benchmarks up to 10 candidate brand names against a structured business context, target audience, and strategic naming priorities.
faq_q3: Are TypeSafe JEV evaluations really deterministic and cache-shared?
faq_a3: Yes. TypeSafe JEV System One processes structured canonical English state contracts. Every audit computes a 64-character deterministic SHA-256 state hash cached in volatile memory for 2 hours. Changing the interface language (French, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese) reuses the identical state hash with zero extra API latency or cost.
faq_q4: How does the Known-Brand Trademark Collision Screen work?
faq_a4: Our offline brand scanner compares the second-level domain (SLD) against an indexed dictionary of over 1,000 famous global trademarks using exact matching, substring overlap, and Levenshtein distance typosquat detection. If a critical collision is flagged, Hard Gate 1 inviolably blocks automated acquisition to safeguard investor capital from UDRP forfeiture.
faq_q5: Why does the engine display 'Price Required' on registered domains?
faq_a5: In accordance with Constitutional Rule 06, {appName} never fabricates an artificial purchase price. When a domain is registered on the secondary market and no asking price is specified by the user, Net EV calculation is honestly suspended until a seller asking price is provided.
faq_q6: Can I customize the scoring weights for my specific investment strategy?
faq_a6: Yes. In the Settings modal, open the Scoring Weights tab to customize composite metric sliders (Brandability, Memorability, Search Intent, Liquidity, TLD Equity, Economics Margin) with instant automatic normalization to 100% and pre-configured investment strategy presets.

privacy_intro_box: Zero-Tracker Commitment: {appName} operates without third-party tracking cookies or marketing pixels. All API keys remain strictly on your client device.
privacy_sec1_desc: {appName} processes domain query strings solely to generate real-time deterministic evaluations through the following open public protocols:
privacy_sec1_li1: RDAP and ICANN registry availability lookups.
privacy_sec1_li2: Public Wayback Machine CDX snapshots and Google Autocomplete patterns.
privacy_sec1_li3: Node.js DNS routing and local offline brand collision scanning.
privacy_sec2_desc: TypeSafe AI API keys entered in Settings are stored strictly in your browser's localStorage. Keys are passed via secure encrypted headers directly to the decision engine and are never logged, stored in databases, or shared with third parties.
privacy_sec3_desc: Evaluations are cached in volatile server memory with a 2-hour TTL based on a deterministic SHA-256 state hash. No personally identifiable information is attached to audit hashes.
privacy_sec4_desc: We do not sell, rent, or monetize domain search queries. External queries are made strictly to open, free telemetry endpoints with a sub-2s timeout.
privacy_sec5_desc: You may clear all local portfolio data, custom weights, and API keys at any time through your browser settings or by clearing localStorage.

terms_sec1_desc: {appName} is a Domain Decision Intelligence engine designed to reduce uncertainty in domain acquisitions, renewals, and brand naming. All composite scores, price ranges, and expected value estimations are deterministic mathematical models.
terms_sec2_desc: Users acknowledge that domain investment carries market liquidity risk. Specifically:
terms_sec2_li1: Brand collision scans compare against a local index of 1,000+ top marks and do not constitute formal USPTO or WIPO legal clearance.
terms_sec2_li2: Net Expected Value (Net EV) calculations represent actuarial scenarios and are not guarantees of resale profit.
terms_sec2_li3: Comparable sales are historical public reported records and do not guarantee future aftermarket valuations.
terms_sec3_desc: Free evidence discovery depends on public third-party endpoints (Internet Archive, Google Suggest, RDAP). {appName} is not responsible for upstream outages or registry rate limits.
